tooltip.copypoly.edit: Sneak + right-click for the world editor. Apply materials like a Create copycat.
screen.copypoly.title: Camouflaged Polyhedral Armor
screen.copypoly.copy_all_help: Copy the entire shape and its links; Ctrl+C copies selected vertices.
screen.copypoly.paste_replace_help: Replace the entire shape; Ctrl+V appends selected vertices and their internal links.
screen.copypoly.drag: 1/2/3 switch modes · Ctrl box select · Right-click add / right-drag orbit
screen.copypoly.world_help: 1 / 2 / 3: vertex / edge / face · Ctrl multi/box-select (includes hidden) · Del delete · Click point: axes, drag point: connect · Right-click add / right-drag look · Ctrl+Z undo
screen.copypoly.mirror_help: Mirror every vertex across the block-center %s plane.
screen.copypoly.rotate_help: Rotate every vertex 90° around the block-center %s axis. Hold Shift for -90°.
screen.copypoly.error.count: Check the vertex count. Automatic hulls need four normal points and explicit meshes need a closed surface.
screen.copypoly.error.paste_limit: Pasting would exceed %s vertices. No vertices were added.
screen.copypoly.error.range: Coordinates must be within the edit bounds and have at most three decimal places.
screen.copypoly.error.flat: Points must enclose a volume, not just a plane.
screen.copypoly.error.mesh: Faces intersect, overlap, collapse or leave an open surface. Adjust the vertices before applying.
screen.copypoly.error.format: Each line needs three coordinates: x, y, z.
screen.copypoly.error.permission: You cannot edit this block here.
screen.copypoly.error.changed: Shape changed elsewhere. Reopen the editor.
screen.copypoly.error.busy: Please wait a moment and apply again.
screen.copypoly.custom.needs_connections: Drag from any vertex to connect; dashed lines activate when they bound a region (%s links).
screen.copypoly.custom.target_not_active: Pending: a target is not on the surface yet (%s links).
screen.copypoly.custom.invalid_boundary: Pending: targets must bound a surface patch; two targets must share an edge (%s links).
screen.copypoly.custom.invalid_surface: Pending: splitting would cross or collapse the surface. Adjust points or links (%s links).
screen.copypoly.clear_faces_help: Keep vertices and clear faces. Select at least three vertices and click New face. Ctrl+Z undoes this.
screen.copypoly.empty_face_selection: Click faces; Ctrl box-select; Del deletes.
screen.copypoly.error.no_faces: Left-click a face to select it first.
screen.copypoly.error.face_polygon: Select at least three distinct non-collinear vertices. Build complex boundaries in smaller pieces.
screen.copypoly.error.face_nonplanar: These vertices are not planar. Create separate triangles instead.
screen.copypoly.draft_open: Open draft: %s boundary edges (orange). Fill the surface before Apply. Ctrl+Z undoes edits.
screen.copypoly.draft_invalid: Crossing, collapsed, overlapping or non-manifold faces. Repair before Apply.
screen.copypoly.gesture_hint: Click point: move. Drag: connect. Click line/face, Del: delete.
screen.copypoly.line_status: Solid: cut surface. Pending dashed lines: %s
screen.copypoly.error.line_crossing: This line would cross an existing cut or leave the surface. Add an intersection vertex or choose another target.
screen.copypoly.error.line_boundary: These lines do not yet partition the surface. Connect more vertices on the same surface.
screen.copypoly.openings_marked: Missing faces are red for 5 seconds. Fill them, then apply; apply again to show the hint.
screen.copypoly.face_selected_help: Surface selected. Del deletes it; click a vertex to select points.
screen.copypoly.line_selected_help: Connection selected. Del disconnects it and keeps endpoints; Ctrl+Z undoes.
screen.copypoly.xray_help: Off hides occluded elements; box selection still includes them. On shows hidden points and edges translucently. Saved automatically.
screen.copypoly.empty_edge_selection: Click edges; Ctrl box-select; Del deletes.
screen.copypoly.multi_help: Edit face-connected polyhedron blocks as one shape.
screen.copypoly.multi_pending: Apply or undo single-block edits first.
screen.copypoly.error.multi_single: There are no connected polyhedron blocks.
screen.copypoly.error.multi_limit: You can edit up to 32 connected blocks at a time.
screen.copypoly.error.multi_complex: The combined mesh is too complex to edit or split.
screen.copypoly.error.multi_empty: The shape must keep some solid volume in each original block.
screen.copypoly.error.multi_outside: The shape extends outside the original group of blocks.
screen.copypoly.error.multi_cell_limit: A split block exceeds 256 vertices or the mesh limit.
screen.copypoly.error.mesh_limit: The mesh exceeds the editor limits.
screen.copypoly.simplify_vertices_help: Remove unused, collinear and coplanar vertices while preserving the surface and drawn cuts.
screen.copypoly.clear_group_holes_help: Clear the recorded holes in this group and refresh the editor.
screen.copypoly.clear_group_holes_pendin: Undo the unapplied edits before clearing holes in the group.
screen.copypoly.clearing_group_holes: Clearing the holes in this group…
screen.copypoly.group_textures_help: Off displays the translucent draft surface. Saved automatically.
